rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Transformation {
    meta:
        description = "Detects transformed Cobalt Strike beacon in memory or dump"
        author = "SOC Intel Team"
        hash = "e86f10ba1c3a8f2e9f8d7c6b5a4e3d2f1e0d9c8b7a6f5e4d3c2b1a0f9e8d7c6b"
    strings:
        $x64_getpeername = { 66 89 44 24 38 8D 44 24 38 }
        $http_post_enc = "POST / HTTP/1.1" wide
        $cfg_junk = { 83 C4 04 33 C0 5A 59 C3 } // common junk bytes pre-config
    condition:
        $x64_getpeername and $http_post_enc and $cfg_junk
}

rule CobaltStrike_Shellcode_Download {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns indicative of Cobalt Strike beacon shellcode download via rundll32"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        severity = "critical"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"
    strings:
        $a = { 6A 00 68 ?? ?? ?? ?? 64 A1 00 00 00 00 6A 00 6A 00 50 6A 01 }
        $b = "ReflectiveLoader" fullword ascii
        $c = { B8 00 00 00 00 83 C0 04 50 68 } // Common syscall stub
    condition:
        all of them
}
